title: Simple Variable Mass 6DOF ECEF (Quaternion)
text: 实现简单变质量六自由度运动方程在地心地球固连（ECEF）坐标中的四元数表示，输入 6 路、输出 14 路；按 {Mass type} 指定质量类型 Simple；{Units}、{Initial position in geodetic latitude, longitude and altitude [mu,l,h]}、{Initial velocity in body axes [U,v,w]}、{Initial Euler orientation [roll, pitch, yaw]}、{Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]}、{Initial mass}、{Empty mass}、{Full mass}、{Inertia}、{Empty inertia}、{Full inertia}、{Include mass flow relative velocity}、{Include inertial acceleration}、{Planet model}、{Equatorial radius}、{Flattening}、{Rotational rate}、{Celestial longitude of Greenwich source}、{Celestial longitude of Greenwich [deg]}、{Celestial longitude of prime meridian source}、{Celestial longitude of prime meridian [deg]}、{Quaternion vector: e.g., ’qr’,’qi’,’qj’,’qk’}、{Body rotation rates: e.g., ’p’,’q’,’r’}、{Velocity: e.g., ’U’,’v’,’w’}、{Fixed frame position: e.g., ’Xff’, ’Yff’, ’Zff’}、{Inertial position: e.g., ’Xinertial’, ’Yinertial’, ’Zinertial’}、{Celestial longitude of Greenwich: e.g., ’LG’}、{Celestial longitude of prime meridian: e.g., ’LPM’}、{Mass: e.g., ’mass’} 同样影响行为。

params.name: Units
params.values: 输入和输出单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)
